items.claim: [r42-1] Nested scroll container hit where its clipping parent hides it
items.note: `scrollablesAt` no longer looks inside a container whose own clip leaves the point out.

items.claim: [r42-2] `segmentUnder` tests the plane path while the affordance tests the camera one
items.note: `inPlane` already carried `run` and `start` into the plane but not `enabled`, so the gates in bend, convert, insert-anchor and tug tested the camera's point against the plane's path. `enabled` is now carried too.

items.claim: [r42-3] A new drag-pan doesn't stop the previous coast
[r42-4] `buildToolActivateBindings` repeats an id on a third spec for one tool and key
items.note: Ids after the second get `.2`, `.3`; the first two keep their old ids.
This was a behavior nobody had ruled on, so I made the call and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`: the fit holds to the axis, and content with no extent on that axis is centered at the current scale.

items.claim: [r42-7] `container.scroll` moves a scaled container by world units
items.note: The world delta is converted to the container's own units, measured through the composition's own `scroll`.
